note: These evals follow the public flagship vault, next-agent-to-hire (group vault_next_agent_to_hire), on the shared gutt stage from a personal login. Any public vault with committed Findings can stand in. No eval may write to memory. Evals 0 and 1 create an artifact page; eval 0 also creates a routine only after the yes it is given.

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-follow next-agent-to-hire — when the plan is shown, answer yes.
evals.expected_output: Checks the vault is readable with list_vaults, finds the window's approved Findings through DECIDES facts with created_after, drills into each Finding and its SUPPORTED_BY SourceDocuments, builds brief.json with kind digest and a 7-day window, and prepares it with vault-pages.cjs prepare digest. Shows one plan (headline, counts, page, routine name, local time and UTC cron, one gutt connector) and waits. On yes it publishes the page, then creates vault-next-agent-to-hire-digest with only the gutt connector and the page URL in its prompt.
assertions: No Artifact publish or RemoteTrigger create happens before the plan is shown and answered
vault-pages.cjs prepare digest is run and passes before the publish
The created routine's mcp_connections has exactly one entry, a gutt connector
The routine's prompt names vault-follow, the slug, --digest and the published page URL
No add_memory, register_agent or other memory write call is made

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-follow next-agent-to-hire --digest <url of a digest page whose brief.json has window.to 7 days ago>
evals.expected_output: Reads brief.json from the page, starts the window the day after its window.to, keeps the last digest at the head of past, and republishes the same URL without force.
assertions: The page's brief.json is read before the publish
The new window.from is the day after the old window.to
The publish passes that url and doesn't pass force
Every change has at least one https source URL

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-follow next-agent-to-hire --digest — in the window, a human-rejected Verdict DECIDES one Finding.
evals.expected_output: Reads the Verdict, sees decision rejected, and leaves that Finding out of changes and retired.
assertions: The rejected Finding's name appears in neither changes nor retired

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-follow next-agent-to-hire — the connected login is a team login: list_vaults returns only vault_team_notes.
evals.expected_output: Says this login can't read the vault and that public vaults are read from a personal login. Publishes nothing and creates no routine.
assertions: No Artifact publish and no RemoteTrigger create is made
The output tells the person to sign in with their personal login

evals.expected_output: Stops with the usage line and points to vault-list.
assertions: No memory, Artifact or RemoteTrigger call is made

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-follow next-agent-to-hire --digest — search_memory_facts returns a timeout error.
evals.expected_output: Says the call failed and publishes nothing. Doesn't publish a digest saying nothing is new.
assertions: The output doesn't say no new findings entered the vault

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-follow next-agent-to-hire --digest — a SUPPORTED_BY search in the window also returns Microsoft (2026-06-18): device-spend cut 23%, a Finding node with status current that a curate run proposed and no Verdict decides.
evals.expected_output: Uses only Findings an approved Verdict DECIDES in the window, so the pending Finding isn't in the digest even though its status says current.
assertions: Microsoft (2026-06-18): device-spend cut 23% isn't in changes
Every change's Finding is the target of a DECIDES fact from an approved Verdict dated in the window
